spans.s:
To sprinkle upon or
with.
--2 To consecrate by
sprinkling holy water; प्राणात्यये तथा श्राद्धे
प्रोक्षितं द्विजकाम्यया

.
--3 To slay, kill. --Caus. To
sprinkle, sprinkle with.

.
--2 Consecration by sprinkling.
--3
Immolation (of animals) at a
sacrifice.
--4 A text to be repeated at
an animal-sacrifice.
--णी, --प्रोक्षणिः
f. Water used for sprinkling or
consecrating, holy water (used in pl.,
and sometimes used to denote ‘the
vessel containing holy water,’ in
which sense the word generally used
is प्रोक्षणीपात्र).

प्रोक्षित p. p.
1 Purified or
consecrated by sprinkling.
--2 Immolated
at a sacrifice.
--3 Offered in sacrifice.

प्रोच्चंड a. Exceedingly frightful or
terrible.

प्रोच्चैस् ind.
1 Very loudly, aloud.
--2 In a very high degree.

प्रोच्छ्रित p. p. High, lofty,
elevated.

प्रोज्झित p. p. Abandoned,
quitted, forsaken, avoided.
प्रोड्डीन a. Flown up or away.

प्रो(प्रौ)ढ a. [प्र + वह् --क्त वा
वृद्धिः]
1 Full-grown, fully
developed, matured, ripened, perfected,
full, (as moon &c.); प्रौढपुष्पैः कदंबैः

.
--3 Thick, dense, pitchy; प्रौढं तमः
कुरु कृतज्ञतयैव भद्रं

.
--7 Luxuriant.
--8
Married.
--9 Full of, filled with (at the
end of comp.)
--10 Raised or lifted
up.
--11 Controverted, discussed.
--ढा A bold and grown-up woman,
no longer bashful or timid in
the presence of her lord, one of the
four principal female characters
in poetic compositions;
आषोडशाद्भवेद्बाला त्रिंशता तरुणी मता । पंचपंचशता प्रौढा
भवेद्वृद्धा ततः परम् ॥.
--Comp.
--अंगना a bold woman; see above.
--उक्तिः f. a bold or pompous
assertion.
--पाद a. one whose feet are
raised on a bench.
--पुष्प a.
having full-grown blossoms;

.
--प्रताप a. of great or mighty
valour.
--योवन a. advanced in
youth.
--वादः an arrogant or bold
assertion, defiant speech.

.
--2
Extended lengthwise or
perpendicularly (opp. ओत).
--3 Tied, bound,
fastened;

.
--5 Passed or
come through; तरुछिद्रप्रोतान् i. e.
(चंद्रोकरणान्) बिसमिति करी
[]
संकलयति K.

.
--7 Joined, connected.
--तं
A garment, woven cloth.
--Comp.
--उत्सादनं {1} an umbrella. {2} a
cloth house, tent.
प्रोतयति Den. P. To insert, infix.

प्रोत्कट (i. e. भृत्यः) A favourite
servant.

प्रोत्कंठ a. Lifting up or
stretching out the neck.
प्रोत्क्रुष्टं A loud noise or uproar
प्रोत्तुंग a. Very high or lofty.

प्रोत्फुल्ल a.
1 Full-blown,
expanded.
--2 Fully dilated, wide open
(eyes).

प्रोत्सारणं Getting rid of,
clearing away, removing, expelling.

प्रोत्सारित p. p.
1 Removed, got
rid of, expelled.
--2 Urged
forward, incited.
--3 Relinquished.
--4
Granted, given.

1 Zeal, ardour.
--2 An
incentive, a stimulus.

1 An inciter,
instigator.
--2 (In law) An instigator of a
crime, an abettor.

प्रोथ् {c1c} U. (प्रोथति-ते)
1 To be
equal to, be a match for, withstand
(with dat.); पुप्रोथास्मै न कश्चत

; 15. 40.
--2 To be able,
adequate or competent.
--3 To be full
or complete.
--4 To subdue,
overpower.
--5 To destroy, slay.

प्रोथ a.
1 Famous, well-known.
--2 Placed, fixed.
--3 Travelling,
going out on a journey, wayfaring;
वृक्षांतमुदकांतं च प्रियं प्रोथमनुव्रजेत् Tv.
--थः --थं
1 The nose or nostrils of
a horse;

; Śi. 11. 11,
12. 73.
--2 The snout of a hog.
--थः
1
The hip, buttocks.
--2 An
excavation.
--3 A garment, old clothes.
--4 Embryo.
--5 Terror, fright.

To sound forth.
--2 To fill with sounds or cries.
--

To cause to resound.
--2
To proclaim loudly.

प्रोद्घुष्ट p. p.
1 Resounding,
resonant.
--2 Making a loud noise.

प्रोद्दीप्त p. p. Set on fire, burning,
blazing;

प्रोद्भिन्न p. p.
1 Germinated,
shot up.
--2 Burst forth.
प्रोद्भूत p. p. Sprung up, arisen.

प्रोद्यत p. p.
1 Lifted up.
--2
Active, industrious.

प्रोन्नत p. p.
1 Very high or
lofty.
--2 Projecting.
--3 Superior
to.
--4 Powerful, strong;

To bloom,
blossom.
--2 To come to light, appear.
--

To open the eyes.
--2 To
reveal, disclose, bring to light,
discover.

प्रोल्लाघित a.
1 Recovered from
kness, convalescent.
--2 Robust.

प्रोषित p. p. Gone abroad, on a
journey, living abroad, away from
home, absent, living in a foreign
country.
--Comp.
--भर्तृका a
woman whose husband is gone
abroad; one of the eight Nāyikās in
erotic poetry. She is thus defined in
S. D.: --नानाकार्यवशाद्यस्या दूरदशें गतः पतिः ।
सा मनोभवदुःखार्ता भवेत् प्रोषितभर्तृका ॥ 119.
--मरणं dying in a foreign country.

प्रो(प्रौ)ष्ठः
1 A bull, an ox.
--2
A bench, stool.
--3 A kind of flish
(ष्ठी also).
--Comp.
--पदः the
month भाद्रपद.
--(दा) the 25th and
26th lunar mansions; पूर्वाभाद्रपदा
and उत्तराभाद्रपदा.
--पाद a. born
under the above Nakṣatra.

प्रो(प्रौ)ह a.
1 A reasoner,
disputant.
--2 Skilful, clever.
--हः
1 Reasoning, logic.
--2 An elephant's
foot or ankle.
--3 A knot, joint.

प्रौ(प्रो)ढिः f.
1 Full growth or
development, maturity, perfection.
--2 Growth, increase.
--3 Greatness,
grandeur, elevation, dignity;

.
--4 Boldness, audacity.
--5
Pride, arrogance, self-confidence.
--6 Controversy, discussion.
--7 Zeal,
exertion, enterprize.
--Comp.
--वादः
{1} a grandiloquent or pompous
speech. {2} a bold assertion.
